verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ad hoc telemetry exploration: Log Management and Dashboards docs exist, users run notebooks for incident and performance debugging, and users can click a field to make it a custom search dimension. Nothing in the pack names or documents a query language or search syntax. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a query language or syntax for metrics, logs or traces; evidence of ad hoc query expressiveness such as aggregations or joins; independent hands-on corroboration of query-language use.
